description: This file defines an abstract class 'TransportConnection' that extends 'ConnectionContext' and manages network connection details such as endpoints, connection ID, features, and connection lifecycle, including abort handling.

classes.name: TransportConnection
classes.description: An abstract class representing a network transport connection, providing properties and methods for managing connection state, endpoints, features, and abort logic.

methods.name: TransportConnection
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection, calling FastReset().

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Overrides the base method to cancel pending reads on the application input pipe, used to abort the connection.
